claims.claim: TakeMe2Space will send its MOI-1A satellite to orbit on October 1 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 on the Transporter-18 rideshare mission.
claims.episode_span: TakeMe2Space will send its MOI-1A satellite to orbit on October 1 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 on the Transporter-18 rideshare mission.
claims.source_title: TakeMe2Space to launch AI computing satellite on SpaceX rocket on 1 October
claims.supporting_quote: TakeMe2Space, a space startup from India, will send its MOI-1A satellite to orbit on 1 October on a SpaceX rideshare flight, Transporter-18.

claims.claim: The satellite weighs less than 50 kilograms and carries Nvidia Orin NX chips built for edge computing.
claims.episode_span: The satellite weighs less than 50 kilograms and carries Nvidia Orin NX chips built for edge computing.
claims.source_title: TakeMe2Space to launch AI computing satellite on SpaceX rocket on 1 October
claims.supporting_quote: The satellite weighs less than 50kg and uses Nvidia’s Orin NX chips, which are designed for edge computing.

claims.claim: Twenty-three customers have already booked capacity on the MOI-1A mission.
claims.episode_span: Twenty-three customers have already booked capacity, including mapping firms, schools, and businesses in farming, mining, supply chains, and insurance.
claims.source_title: TakeMe2Space to launch AI computing satellite on SpaceX rocket on 1 October
claims.supporting_quote: So far, 23 customers have booked space on the mission, the company said.

claims.claim: Contractors have filed $53 million in new liens against SpaceXAI-linked properties in Memphis and Southaven.

claims.claim: A Falcon 9 booster completed its tenth flight during a recent Starlink mission and landed on the droneship Of Course I Still Love You.
claims.episode_span: A Falcon 9 booster completed its tenth flight during a recent Starlink mission. The booster landed on the droneship Of Course I Still Love You after deploying its payload.
